components.name: Steps
components.description: An ordered sequence with a current position. Each Step works out whether it is complete, active or upcoming, and exposes it as `data-state` for its parts to style. Every part inside is optional: steps, dots, segmented bars and checklists are all layouts of the same pieces.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets people pick a step through its StepTrigger.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Keeps the steps visible but blocks picking, e.g. while saving.

props.name: status
props.description: Overrides the state worked out from the current step.

components.name: StepTrigger
components.description: Picks its step when pressed. A button when the Steps are interactive, a plain element otherwise.

components.name: StepIndicator
components.description: The marker for a step. Shows a check, cross or spinner for complete, error and loading; otherwise its children, or the step number when empty.

components.name: StepSeparator
components.description: The line from a step to the next one. Place it inside the Step it leaves; it fills in once that step is passed.
